skill.name: product-launch-video
skill.description: Create a product launch video from a product URL, marketing brief, or approved script using HyperFrames workflows.
skill.summary: Builds storyboarded product launch videos with capture, brand styling, audio, captions, and final rendering steps.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: The skill is a substantial HyperFrames video production workflow with many scanner false positives from Markdown backticks, relative documentation links, and JavaScript RegExp.exec calls. Confirmed concerns are limited to unpinned CLI execution with global updates, environment-selected audio engine execution, HeyGen credential use, and remote GSAP CDN loading.

remediation.issue: Unpinned HyperFrames CLI commands can update the global skill set.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the HyperFrames CLI version and require explicit user confirmation before any global skill update from GitHub.

remediation.issue: HF_MEDIA_ENGINE can redirect audio processing to a different local script.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict the engine override to trusted paths or prompt the user before executing an environment-selected engine.

remediation.issue: Audio workflow depends on the hidden ~/.heygen credential.
remediation.suggestion: Document exactly when the credential is read and provide an offline path that never touches the credential file.

remediation.issue: Generated HTML loads GSAP from jsDelivr.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a pinned local GSAP asset or add an integrity-checked dependency path for offline and deterministic renders.

content.value_statement: Product teams need polished launch videos without rebuilding the process for every campaign. This skill turns a URL, script, or brief into a guided HyperFrames video workflow.
actual_capabilities: Captures product sites and extracts brand text, colors, fonts, and assets.
Creates a launch brief, storyboard, script, and frame-by-frame plan.
Applies a selected HyperFrames frame preset to the captured brand style.
Generates or syncs narration, music, sound effects, captions, and frame durations.
Assembles frame HTML, injects transitions, validates the project, and renders an MP4.
limitations: Requires the HyperFrames CLI and related sibling skills to be installed.
Uses local Node scripts and external media tools during the workflow.
HeyGen audio and some capture features require valid user credentials or provider keys.
Designed for product launches, not general website tours or topic explainers.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a feature page and launch angle into a narrated video with branded visuals and captions.

use_cases.title: Promote an App Release
use_cases.description: Convert an app URL and release notes into a short launch video for social and sales channels.

use_cases.title: Produce Sales Enablement Clips
use_cases.description: Create repeatable product videos that explain benefits, proof points, and calls to action.

prompt_templates.title: Start From a URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45 second product launch video for this product page: [URL]. Use a confident tone and landscape format.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Script Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product launch video from this script. Keep the narration mostly verbatim, but improve pacing and visual beats.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Campaign Angle
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a launch video for [product] aimed at [audience]. Emphasize [main benefit], [proof point], and [call to action].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Multi-Format Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a launch video plan for landscape first, then note changes needed for portrait and square versions after approval.

output_examples.input: A SaaS homepage URL and a request for a 30 second launch promo.
output_examples.output: A locked brief, captured brand assets, approved storyboard, narrated script, animated frames, captions, and a rendered video file.

output_examples.input: A pasted launch script with a request to keep the voiceover unchanged.
output_examples.output: A frame plan that follows the script, maps each beat to visuals, syncs audio timing, and prepares final review.

output_examples.input: A product brief with no website or assets.
output_examples.output: A no-capture project using supplied brand notes, a generated storyboard, local assets, and a render-ready HyperFrames structure.

best_practices: Confirm the product, audience, angle, format, and language before generating frames.
Use captured brand tokens and approved assets as the source of truth.
Review the storyboard and final preview before rendering the MP4.
anti_patterns: Use this skill for a general website walkthrough with no launch message.
Skip user approval for storyboard or final render decisions.
Insert unapproved assets or claims that were not present in the brief or capture.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It can start from a product URL, a marketing brief, a pasted script, or a combination of those inputs.

faq.question: Does it create the final video file?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow can assemble, validate, preview, and render a final MP4 after user approval.

faq.question: Can it work without HeyGen sign-in?
faq.answer: It can continue offline for some steps, but HeyGen audio and catalog media need valid user credentials.

faq.question: Can I use it for non-product explainers?
faq.answer: No. The skill routes topic explainers, website tours, and motion graphics to other workflows.

faq.question: Does it use captured website assets?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses captured brand text, colors, fonts, and selected assets when available.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
